sheetHint.open: Not submitted yet for this pay period. Its time can still change.
sheetHint.submitted: Submitted and locked. A manager or an admin approves it or sends it back.
sheetHint.approved: Approved and locked. It goes into the payroll export.
sheetHint.rejected: Sent back to be fixed. It’s open to changes until it’s submitted again.
sheetHint.reportsOnly: Doesn’t submit timesheets: their time counts in project reports and the overview, not in payroll.

timeOffStatusHint.pending: Waiting for a manager or an admin to approve it. Not paid until then.
timeOffStatusHint.approved: Approved: it’s paid with the pay period it falls in.
